A few small uncontrolled studies have reported improvements in heart failure (p.1165) with the use of growth hormone.1 A meta-analysis2 of 12 studies using growth hormone in adults with chronic heart failure, including 8 placebo-controlled studies, also found evidence for improve- ment in several cardiovascular measures; however, individual re- sults have been mixed and further study of long-term high-dose therapy is needed.
